candidate.derivedAnswer: A. A quadrilateral with three right angles
candidate.answerReason: The fourth angle is 360° − 3 × 90° = 90°, so the quadrilateral is a rectangle. The other conditions do not guarantee a rectangle.

methods.label: Use the rectangle criteria
methods.explanation: When three angles are right angles, the fourth angle is also a right angle. A quadrilateral with four right angles is a rectangle. A quadrilateral with equal diagonals (such as an isosceles trapezoid) is not necessarily a rectangle. A parallelogram with perpendicular diagonals is a rhombus.
methods.levelReason: The argument uses Grade 8 quadrilateral angle sums and rectangle and rhombus criteria.
